Name: Video Agent by Fotor
Tagline: Create and edit precision motion graphics & video with chat
Description: Fotor Video Agent helps founders, marketers, and creators turn ideas, scripts, or raw assets into precision videos & motion graphics. It auto-orchestrates scenes, timing, visual FX, and kinetic typography—while keeping text, numbers, logos, and charts editable on a multi-track timeline before you render. Update stats at the last minute or refine timing without regenerating the whole video. Ship promos and explainers faster with zero black-box outputs and no tedious keyframes.

Name: EP–2350 FX–MIC
Tagline: The programmable mic you can squeeze, shake & play
Description: EP–2350 FX–MIC is a standalone handheld performance microphone with built-in fx, 4 on-board samples and a parameter modulation lever. shape your vocals and trigger samples straight from the mic. fill the four sample slots with your own sounds and build your own effect presets using a simple json file. hook it up to your K.O. II or plug it straight into any setup.

Name: Interactive Sessions
Tagline: Drive the full SDLC with AI agents, step by step
Topics: Software Engineering, Developer Tools, Artificial Intelligence
Description: Different work needs different AI oversight, and Revolte gives you both. Our Interactive Sessions let you drive the full lifecycle with the agents, step by step: architecture, code, tests, staging, deploy. You approve every step. Autopilot mode hands off a Jira ticket end-to-end, with agents planning, coding, opening the PR, and deploying. Same workspace, same governance: plan approval, inline diffs, cost caps, and audit trails, built in. Hands-on when you want control, hands-off when you don't.

Name: BrandJet
Tagline: Turn public buying signals into sales pipeline
Description: BrandJet turns live buying signals into outbound pipeline. It listens across X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and the open web for people asking about problems you solve, enriches every relevant signal into a lead, and reaches them on the channels they actually use. From first signal to outreach, unified inbox, CRM, and signed contract, BrandJet runs the entire motion in one platform. It's exposed through MCP so AI agents can run it too.

Name: WebTerm Learn
Tagline: Learn the terminal like a game — in a browser sandbox
Description: An interactive platform for learning the terminal, Git, and Vim. Hand-drawn slides teach the concept; a real in-browser sandbox checks every command you type. Progress across a 3D world map with a companion that evolves. 12 courses, 129 lessons, all free.

Name: StackScope
Tagline: See what new sites are built with, the week they launch
Description: See which sites started using Stripe, Shopify or Next.js this week. Most of what we index we find ourselves: over 2.2+ million sites from public infrastructure signals, not submitted to us, across 40,000+ technologies. When we reach a launch before the boards, we're 14.5 days early. Browsing is free. Paid plans add Stackdar alerts, API access, bulk export with published contact details, and an MCP server for Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor.

Name: Orato
Tagline: Practice speaking with AI.
Description: Pick a drill, speak for 30 to 90 seconds, and get scored on pacing, fluency, vocabulary and coherence. Every filler and long pause lands on a transcript you can read back. On an iPhone with Apple Intelligence it runs on the device, with no account.

Name: Tether
Tagline: A ball for boring meetings to keep you busy
Description: A ball hangs from your Mac menu bar on an elastic tether. Drag it, fling it, slingshot it. It bounces off your actual app windows, rolls along their edges and settles into the Dock. Cut the rope and it goes loose across the desktop. Real physics, not a canned animation, so it never does the same thing twice. One key hides it the instant somebody says your name. No account, no subscription, nothing leaves your Mac.

Name: Radar by Particle
Tagline: The Podcast Search Engine
Description: The web is searchable. Podcasts should be too. Today, Particle is introducing Radar, the podcast search engine. Podcasts hold some of the most thoughtful and timely conversations happening right now, but that knowledge is hard to find. Radar searches 130,000+ actively transcribed podcasts, with ~20,000 new episodes daily. Millions of hours and billions of lines, fully searchable. Radar is powered by Particle’s Podcast Intelligence API, which allows agents to search across podcasts via API/MCP.

Name: FrameOS
Tagline: Record your iOS & Android screen from your Mac.
Description: Record iPhone, iPad and Android app demos on your Mac. Add camera, mic, transitions, zooms and masks, then export polished videos and screenshots.

Name: BrandMyLaptop
Tagline: Sell ad space on your laptop
Description: A marketplace where brands buy sticker spots on your laptop lid. Set your machine, your prices, your terms. Mac or PC, one you own or one the sales pay for.

Name: CreditFX
Tagline: Stop counting credits. Start understanding them.
Description: AI platforms have created their own currencies: credits, tokens, minutes, generations, and more. CreditFX translates them into real-world usage and dollar rates so you can understand what you're actually paying for. Calculate what your credits get you, or use the Usage Planner on supported platforms to start with what you want to create and see the credits, plan, and estimated cost required. Free to use. No account required.

Name: LeaseBase
Tagline: AI that tells landlords what to do, not just what happened
Description: California rent caps, deposit limits, and required disclosures change by city — and the penalties are real. LeaseBase tracks every deadline and handles payments, maintenance, and leases in one place. Self-manage with confidence.

Name: Sunday Club
Tagline: One hand-picked product launch, every Monday
Description: Sunday Club picks one weekly shortlist of new products, vetted by hand. Vote, discuss, and follow the makers behind them. No algorithm, no streaks. Just one calm edition every Monday.

Name: Mascofast
Tagline: text to animated mascot in minutes
Description: MascoFast turns a simple idea into a production-ready mascot for your app, game, or SaaS product. Generate a distinctive character, refine its look, create poses and animations, and export transparent assets ready for your UI, onboarding, marketing, and product experiences—all in one developer-friendly workflow.

Name: Rival Radar
Tagline: AI-powered competitor pricing & feature tracking
Description: Rival Radar watches your competitors' pricing, features, and messaging around the clock and tells you in plain English what changed and why it matters. Just describe your business and AI finds your competitors for you, no manual research is needed. Every check filters out cosmetic noise, so you only hear about true changes, ranked by how much they matter. Free for 3 competitors, checked daily and no payment required.

Name: Influencer Finder
Tagline: Find 10 influencers for free and no signup
Description: Paste your company website and our AI surfaces 10 Instagram and TikTok creators whose content actually matches what you sell. Free to run.

Name: Bookhoarder
Tagline: Self-hosted EPUB library with no database
Description: BookHoarder turns a local folder, S3 bucket, or Cloudflare R2 bucket into a browsable EPUB library. Read in the browser, keep progress for each profile, organize shelves, fetch metadata from Open Library, send books by email, or connect through OPDS. There is no database to run or migrate. Deploy it with Docker, Kubernetes, or Cloudflare Workers.

Name: Audio Converter AI
Tagline: Convert speech, text, and audio formats with AI.
Description: Audio Converter AI transcribes audio and video to text with high accuracy, supports 200+ languages, and offers speaker identification, smart summaries, and timestamps. It also includes TTS, voice changing, and format conversion (MP3, WAV, FLAC, AAC, OGG, M4A, MP4). Handles files up to 5GB, batch processes 5 at once. Free, no sign-up, browser-based. Perfect for lectures, podcasts, interviews, and meetings.

Name: GrokTemplates
Tagline: A free directory of Grok Bot templates, copy or install
Description: GrokTemplates is a free directory of Grok Bot templates. No signup. Templates are written out in full: the bot profile, the skill, and the routine, as plain text with a copy button on each. One-click installs are bots other people published as x.ai share links, credited to whoever built them. Every template names what it reads, what it writes, and what to do when a run finds nothing. Search and category filters on both. Star what works. Submit yours.
